proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 14 million free tokens on signup, plus daily login bonus credits. Runs FLUX.1-schnell at ~0.01 credits per image.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast API access to FLUX.1-schnell, SDXL, and other open-source image models without cold starts, bypasses GitHub Actions IP blocks common with HuggingFace.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Image generation pipeline in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' via simple curl requests in GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires phone verification for API key; UI is occasionally in Chinese but the API documentation and endpoints are fully standard English OpenAI-compatible.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per month, reset monthly.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any URL (including JS-heavy e-commerce pages) into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown with a single GET request. Completely bypasses complex scraping/parsing logic.
proposals.would_integrate_where: 'agent_trendhunter' and 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to scrape trending Etsy keywords, Redbubble tag pages, or Kickstarter game campaigns directly from GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Highly popular target sites may occasionally trigger Cloudflare blocks, requiring clean headers or rotating proxies.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list and host. No monthly fees. Commission split per sale (you keep up to 70% of digital, standard POD margins for physical).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The premier print-on-demand marketplace specifically for custom card games, tabletop RPG aids, and print-and-play PDFs. Built-in organic traffic of hardcore tabletop gamers.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Primary distribution target for 'produce_card_game' and 'produce_specs_deck' to capture high-intent tabletop buyers.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict formatting templates for PDF uploads; manual proofing of the first physical card deck is recommended but not mandatory for digital-only sales.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Dozens of high-tier LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma 2) are 100% free with generous rate limits.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Unified API interface for hundreds of open and closed-source models. If Gemini experiences downtime or rate limits, OpenRouter provides instantaneous failover to equivalent free models.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Added to 'agent_brain_meta' multi-model fallback configuration as the ultimate safety net for all 5 perpetual brains.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Free models can experience high latency during peak hours due to shared global pool usage.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Traces black-and-white bitmaps (like AI-generated line art) into clean, infinitely scalable vector graphics (SVG/PDF) locally. Completely eliminates the need for expensive vectorization APIs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Runs as a headless step inside GitHub Actions runner right after image generation in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_svg_pack'.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Only works effectively on strictly black-and-white or high-contrast source images; gray gradients require preprocessing (thresholding).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload designs, set up a 'Store' or 'Club' to sell digital STL/3MF files. 10% platform fee on sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Backed by Prusa 3D. Massive organic, high-trust community of 3D printer owners. Significantly less saturated and higher conversion rate than Cults3D for functional or parametric models.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Secondary distribution channel for parametric 3D designs generated in 'produce_stl_parametric'.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: To gain initial traction, uploading some high-quality free models is highly recommended to build 'Prism' points and reputation.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload and open a shop. Earn 10% to 15% royalty on fabric, wallpaper, and home goods sold.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A highly specialized POD focusing purely on repeating patterns. Attracts interior designers, quilters, and DIY crafters who buy large quantities, leading to high-ticket order commissions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target distribution platform for seamless patterns generated via 'produce_tumbler_wraps' or a dedicated seamless pattern pipeline.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: To sell publicly, you must order a physical proof of your design (or a swatch book) to verify print quality, meaning a small upfront investment is eventually required per collection.
